summary: Iteration 166 - Merchant Platform V5 Business Automation VERIFIED. All features working correctly: Login redirect fix (URL changes from /login to / after successful login), Business Automation tab visible in Merchant Portal, Dashboard renders KPI overview, Automation Controls (toggles + steppers) are interactive, Full Automation Run button works without 500 errors, APIs return structured data with skipped/completed status when no pending actions.

tests: test_get_business_automation_dashboard - PASS (returns settings, overview, procurement, operations, revenue, history)
test_run_operations_automation - PASS (status=skipped when no late staff/alerts)
test_run_revenue_automation - PASS (status=skipped when no stale listings)
Login redirect - PASS (URL changes from /login to / after successful login)
Full Automation Run button visible (merchant-v5-business-automation-run-full) - PASS
Procurement toggle visible and interactive (merchant-v5-automation-toggle-procurement) - PASS
Toggle controls interactive - PASS (Procurement toggle changed from Aktiv to Pausiert)
Stepper controls interactive - PASS (Days of Cover incremented)

login_redirect_fix.details: After successful login with admin@bidblitz.ae, URL changes from /login to / (not stuck on /login). Frontend handleAuthSuccess and syncBrowserPath correctly redirect user.

business_automation_tab.details: Business Automation tab (merchant-tab-business-automation) is visible in Merchant Portal tab bar alongside Dashboard, Enterprise V5, Executive AI, etc.

business_automation_dashboard.details: Dashboard renders: KPI Overview (Procurement, Operations, Revenue, Open Tasks counts), Automation Controls (toggles for each module), Stepper settings (Days of Cover, Flash Discount, Flash Minutes, Late Grace), Action cards (Procurement Run, Operations Run, Revenue Run), Automation History with run status.

toggle_stepper_controls.details: Toggle controls are interactive - clicking Procurement toggle changes state from 'Aktiv' to 'Pausiert'. Stepper controls work - clicking + on Days of Cover increments value. API saves settings successfully.

full_automation_run.details: Full Automation Run button works without 500 error. Returns ok=true with summary showing purchase_orders_created, tasks_created, flash_sales_created. History is updated with new run entry showing 'completed' status.

api_robustness.details: APIs handle empty data gracefully - when no procurement recommendations, late staff, or stale listings exist, runs return 'skipped' status instead of errors. This is the expected behavior per requirements.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly handles empty data scenarios - returns 'skipped' status instead of errors when no procurement recommendations, late staff, or revenue opportunities exist
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements enabling robust automated testing
Login redirect fix implemented via handleAuthSuccess callback and syncBrowserPath with 'replace' mode
Business Automation settings are persisted to MongoDB collection 'merchant_automation_settings' and retrieved correctly
Automation runs are recorded in 'merchant_automation_runs' collection with proper timestamps and summaries
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded admin account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 166 verified Merchant Platform V5 Business Automation features. Login redirect fix works (URL changes from /login to / after login). Business Automation tab is visible in Merchant Portal. Dashboard shows KPI overview, toggle/stepper controls, action cards, and history. All automation run endpoints work correctly - they return 'skipped' status when no pending actions exist (no low-stock items, no late staff, no stale listings), which is expected behavior. Full Automation Run button works without 500 errors.

mocked_apis.note: All endpoints use real backend with MongoDB. Business Automation uses real data from POS, Inventory, Staff, and Marketplace modules.
